articles.company_name: National Grid Transco PLC National Grid PLC (NEW)
articles.summary: As part of National Grid’s wider £40 billion investment programme to upgrade the UK’s energy infrastructure, the company is today announcing £624 million of contracts across 78 companies in England and Wales, giving businesses of all sizes a key role in modernising the country’s strategic electricity network.
articles.title: National Grid investment programme supports UK supply chains and regional growth
